claims.claim_text: HEICO is a leading supplier/distributor/integrator of military aircraft parts to the U.S. Department of Defense and defense prime contractors, including F-16 fighter aircraft support.
claims.subject: HEICO Flight Support Group (FSG)
claims.source_quote: the FSG is a leading supplier, distributor, and integrator of military aircraft parts and support services primarily to the U.S. Department of Defense, defense prime contractors, and foreign military organizations allied with the U.S. Further, we believe the FSG is a leading provider of products and services necessary to maintain up-to-date F-16 fighter aircraft operational capabilities.

claims.claim_text: ETG derived ~51% of its FY2025 net sales from sales to U.S. and foreign military agencies, prime defense contractors, and both commercial and defense satellite/spacecraft manufacturers.
claims.subject: HEICO Electronic Technologies Group (ETG)
claims.source_quote: The ETG derived approximately 51%, 51% and 49% of its net sales in fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively, from the sale of products and services to U.S. and foreign military agencies, prime defense contractors and both commercial and defense satellite and spacecraft manufacturers.

claims.claim_text: Since 1990 HEICO has completed approximately 107 acquisitions and grew net sales from $26.2M to $4,485.0M (CAGR ~16%) under a 'disciplined acquisition strategy'. FY2025 acquisitions consumed $629.8M of cash with four acquisitions (SVM Private Limited, Millennium International, Rosen Aviation, Gables Engineering) being excluded from FY2025 ICFR assessment.
claims.subject: HEICO acquisition rollup
claims.source_quote: Since 1990, we have completed approximately 107 acquisitions complementing the niche segments of the aviation, defense, space, medical, telecommunications and electronics industries... management elected to exclude SVM Private Limited, Millennium International, LLC, Rosen Aviation, LLC, and Gables Engineering, Inc. (collectively, the 'Excluded Acquisitions') from its assessment of internal control over financial reporting as of October 31, 2025.

kwargs.parent_thesis: Niche FAA-approved aerospace aftermarket PMA parts + defense electronics subsystems for aircraft, spacecraft and satellites, acquired and integrated as autonomous niche units within HEICO's two segments (FSG and ETG).
acquisitions: Axillon Aerospace Fuel Containment (military aircraft fuel bladders, announced Nov 2025)

claims.claim_text: FY2025 acquisitions used $629.8M cash and HEICO took $495M in revolver borrowings to fund acquisitions; total debt $2.17B as of Oct 31, 2025 with senior unsecured notes ($600M 5.25% 2028 + $600M 5.35% 2033) plus $2.0B revolver expandable to $2.75B.
claims.subject: HEICO debt-funded acquisitions
claims.source_quote: Net cash used in investing activities totaled $731.7 million in fiscal 2025 and related primarily to acquisitions of $629.8 million... $495.0 million of borrowings on our revolving credit facility to fund certain fiscal 2025 acquisitions... $600 million principal amount of 5.25% Senior Notes due August 1, 2028 (the '2028 Notes') and $600 million principal amount of 5.35% Senior Notes due August 1, 2033

claims.claim_text: HEICO maintains a global facility footprint: FSG operates U.S. manufacturing/distribution facilities across 19 states (~1.86M sqft) and international facilities in 10 countries (France, Germany, India, Laos, Netherlands, Singapore, Thailand, Turkey, UAE, UK); ETG operates U.S. facilities in 19 states (~1.67M sqft) and international facilities in 7 countries (Canada, France, India, Morocco, South Korea, UK, Vietnam). Corporate HQ in Hollywood, Florida.
claims.subject: HEICO global facility footprint
claims.source_quote: Flight Support Group United States facilities (19 states) 1,582,000 280,000... International facilities (10 countries) - France, Germany, India, Laos, Netherlands, Singapore, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates and United Kingdom... Electronic Technologies Group United States facilities (19 states) 906,000 759,000... International facilities (7 countries) - Canada, France, India, Morocco, South Korea, United Kingdom and Vietnam

claims.claim_text: HEICO has received PMAs from the FAA for approximately 20,000 jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts and is currently adding 400-550 PMAs per year. The company has no material patents covering its core PMA manufacturing techniques and instead relies on trade secret protection.
claims.subject: HEICO FSG intellectual property
claims.source_quote: we are now adding new products to our line at a rate of approximately 400 to 550 Parts Manufacturer Approvals (PMA or PMAs) per year. We have developed for our customers approximately 20,000 parts for which PMAs have been received from the FAA... We have no material patents for the proprietary techniques, including software and manufacturing expertise, we have developed to manufacture jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts and instead, we primarily rely on trade secret protection.

claims.claim_text: HEICO's ICFR was assessed effective as of October 31, 2025 by management and audited as effective by Deloitte & Touche LLP with an unqualified attestation. Four acquired entities (SVM Private Limited, Millennium International, Rosen Aviation, Gables Engineering) were excluded from the FY2025 ICFR assessment as permitted by SEC.
claims.subject: HEICO ICFR
claims.source_quote: Based on its assessment, management concluded that the Company's internal control over financial reporting is effective as of October 31, 2025... In our opinion, the Company maintained, in all material respects, effective internal control over financial reporting as of October 31, 2025... management excluded from its assessment the internal control over financial reporting at SVM Private Limited, Millennium International, LLC, Rosen Aviation, LLC, and Gables Engineering, Inc.
